daily_report_items: Roblox has a medium-confidence baseline assessment but is uncompetitive with cash: a bounded 12-month scenario indicates 46.9% downside and 18.4% base-case downside from the current mark, while safety headwinds and dilution remain material.

Safety headwinds reduced 2026 bookings growth guidance to 8-12% and free-cash-flow guidance to USD 1.05-1.275 billion; fully diluted shares were 749 million.
RBLX closed at USD 47.54999923706055 on 2026-07-24 with volume 4,718,600, and the USD/EUR rate was 0.8787999749183655 on 2026-07-27; both inputs passed final strict integrity checks.
evidence.source: PaperTrader deterministic market and FX caches

summary: Revalidated Roblox with freshly registered Q1 2026 issuer evidence, a fresh USD 47.55 market mark, and current USD/EUR data. Engagement, bookings, and cash generation remain strong, but safety-driven guidance reductions, creator and infrastructure costs, GAAP losses, and dilution constrain value. A bounded 12-month free-cash-flow scenario gives USD 25.23 downside and USD 38.80 base values, implying -46.9% and -18.4%; the medium-confidence assessment is baseline-classified but has a 30.6 effective score and is uncompetitive with cash. No strategy follow-up was enqueued.
